import json
from robot import tools, handoff, target
from ora_lib import current, object_geometry, offset

RISE_TARGET_M = 0.15      # raise the roller this far above its resting height (> 0.10 required)
RETAIN_MIN_M  = 0.015     # the object must come up with the gripper by at least this much after the grasp lift

def find_roller():
    r = tools.vision_ground(camera="head", text="paint roller with yellow stripes", max_candidates=3)
    best = None
    for c in r["result"]["candidates"]:
        g = object_geometry(c)
        isr = (g.status == "localized" and g.height_above_support_m > 0.02 and g.largest_extent_m > 0.11)
        print("cand", c["candidate_id"], "ext", round(g.largest_extent_m,3), "h_sup", round(g.height_above_support_m,3),
              "center", [round(v,3) for v in g.center_xyz_m], "roller?", isr)
        if isr:
            best = (c, g)
    return best

found = find_roller()
if found is None:
    handoff("paint roller not localized in head view")
c0, g0 = found
rest_bottom = g0.center_xyz_m[2] - g0.extent_xyz_m[2] / 2.0
print("rest_bottom_z", round(rest_bottom,4), "center_z", round(g0.center_xyz_m[2],4), "target_ref", c0["target_ref"])

gp = tools.grasp_plan(arm="right", target_ref=c0["target_ref"], max_candidates=3)
cands = gp["result"]["candidates"]
if not cands:
    handoff("no grasp candidate for roller", status=gp.status, target=c0["candidate_id"])
best = cands[0]
print("grasp", best["candidate_id"], "open_mm", round(best["gripper_opening_m"]*1000,1),
      "contact", best["contact_pose"]["position_m"])

r = tools.grasp_execute(candidate_id=best["candidate_id"],
                        rationale="top-down grasp across the roller sleeve near its centre")
print("grasp_execute ok", r.ok, "status", r.status, "failure", r.failure_code, "err_m", r.target_error_m)
print(json.dumps(r.raw, default=str)[:3500])
if not r.ok:
    handoff("grasp_execute did not complete", status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code, summary=r.summary)

# re-measure the roller with the fresh observation
found2 = find_roller()
if found2 is None:
    handoff("roller not localized after grasp lift", tcp=current().pose("right").position.xyz.tolist())
c1, g1 = found2
new_bottom = g1.center_xyz_m[2] - g1.extent_xyz_m[2] / 2.0
rise1 = new_bottom - rest_bottom
print("after grasp lift: bottom", round(new_bottom,4), "rise", round(rise1,4))
if rise1 < RETAIN_MIN_M:
    handoff("roller did not rise with the grasp", rise_m=rise1, tol_m=RETAIN_MIN_M,
            status=r.status, summary=r.summary, target=c1["candidate_id"])

# raise the held roller further: needs RISE_TARGET_M above its resting bottom
need_m = (rest_bottom + RISE_TARGET_M) - new_bottom
print("extra lift needed", round(need_m,4))
p_tcp = current().pose("right").position
if need_m > 0:
    dest = offset(p_tcp, dz=need_m, frame="world")
    mr = tools.move_pose(targets={"right": target(dest, interaction="precision")}, speed="normal")
    print("lift move", mr.ok, mr.status, mr.failure_code, "err_m", mr.target_error_m, mr.summary)
    if not mr.ok:
        handoff("extra lift move failed", status=mr.status, failure=mr.failure_code, summary=mr.summary)

# verify with a fresh measurement
found3 = find_roller()
tcp_now = current().pose("right").position
if found3 is None:
    handoff("roller not localized after extra lift", tcp=tcp_now.xyz.tolist())
c2, g2 = found3
final_bottom = g2.center_xyz_m[2] - g2.extent_xyz_m[2] / 2.0
rise_final = final_bottom - rest_bottom
print("FINAL bottom", round(final_bottom,4), "rise", round(rise_final,4), "tcp", [round(v,3) for v in tcp_now.xyz])
if rise_final < 0.10:
    handoff("rise below task threshold", rise_m=rise_final, required_m=0.10, tcp=tcp_now.xyz.tolist())
print("VERIFIED rise", round(rise_final,4), "m above rest; exceeds 0.10 m")

import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from robot import tools, query, target, handoff
from ora_lib import current, object_geometry, Pose

REST = json.load(open("/work/baseline.json"))
REST_BOTTOM = REST["rest_bottom_z_m"]
APP_OFF_M = 0.1501
GOAL_JAW_RISE_M = 0.145      # the object moves rigidly with the jaw: ensure > 0.10 m with margin

pose = current().pose("right")
q = np.array(pose.xyzw, float); p = np.array(pose.position.xyz, float)
app = np.array(pose.axis("x").xyz, float)
jaw_z0 = p[2] + APP_OFF_M * app[2]
print("tcp", np.round(p,4), "jaw_z", round(jaw_z0,4))

r = tools.vision_ground(camera="head", text="paint roller with yellow stripes", max_candidates=3)
g = None
for c in r["result"]["candidates"]:
    gg = object_geometry(c)
    if gg.status == "localized" and gg.height_above_support_m > 0.02 and gg.largest_extent_m > 0.10:
        g = gg
centre = np.array(g.center_xyz_m)
print("roller center", np.round(centre,4), "aabb_min_z", round(g.aabb_min_xyz_m[2],4), "axis", np.round(g.principal_axis_world,3))

poses, meta = [], []
for tilt in (0.0, 15.0, 30.0):
    Ry = R.from_rotvec([0.0, np.deg2rad(tilt), 0.0]) * R.from_quat(q)
    qc = Ry.as_quat(); ac = Ry.apply([1.0, 0.0, 0.0])
    for yy in (centre[1] - 0.08, centre[1] - 0.16):
        for rise in (0.15, 0.18):
            z = jaw_z0 + rise - APP_OFF_M * abs(ac[2]) * (-1.0)   # jaw_z = z + APP*ac[2]; ac[2] = -cos(tilt)
            poses.append([float(centre[0]), float(yy), float(z), *map(float, qc)])
            meta.append((tilt, float(yy), float(z), ac))
chk = query("reach_check", arm="right", poses=poses)
rows = chk.get("results", [])
best = None
for i, row in enumerate(rows):
    tilt, yy, zz, ac = meta[i]
    rise_pred = (zz + APP_OFF_M * ac[2]) - jaw_z0
    print(i, "tilt", tilt, "y", round(yy,3), "z", round(zz,3), "reach", row.get("reachable"), row.get("reason"),
          "margin", None if row.get("joint_limit_margin_deg") is None else round(row["joint_limit_margin_deg"],1),
          "rise_pred", round(rise_pred,4))
    if row.get("reachable") and rise_pred >= 0.12:
        key = (round(rise_pred, 4), -tilt)
        if best is None or key > best[0]:
            best = (key, i, poses[i], rise_pred)
if best is None:
    handoff("no reachable lift pose", rows=rows, jaw_z0=jaw_z0)
_, idx, tgt, rise_pred = best
print("CHOSEN", idx, "tilt", meta[idx][0], "y", round(meta[idx][1],3), "z", round(meta[idx][2],3), "rise_pred", round(rise_pred,4))
dest = Pose(tgt[:3], tgt[3:], frame="world")

dr = tools.move_pose(targets={"right": target(dest, interaction="precision")}, speed="normal", dry_run=True)
print("dry feasible", dr.feasible, "summary", dr.summary, "failure", dr.failure_code)
if not dr.feasible:
    handoff("lift path infeasible", summary=dr.summary, failure=dr.failure_code)
res = tools.move_pose(targets={"right": target(dest, interaction="precision")}, speed="normal")
print("LIFT", res.ok, res.status, res.failure_code, "err_m", res.target_error_m, res.summary)
if not res.ok:
    handoff("lift failed", status=res.status, failure=res.failure_code, summary=res.summary)

p2 = current().pose("right"); pp2 = np.array(p2.position.xyz, float); app2 = np.array(p2.axis("x").xyz, float)
jaw_rise = (pp2[2] + APP_OFF_M*app2[2]) - jaw_z0
r2 = tools.vision_ground(camera="head", text="paint roller with yellow stripes", max_candidates=3)
g2 = None
for c in r2["result"]["candidates"]:
    gg = object_geometry(c)
    print("cand", c["candidate_id"], "ext", round(gg.largest_extent_m,3), "h", round(gg.height_above_support_m,3),
          "center", [round(v,3) for v in gg.center_xyz_m], "aabb_min_z", round(gg.aabb_min_xyz_m[2],4))
    if gg.status == "localized" and gg.largest_extent_m > 0.10 and gg.height_above_support_m > 0.06:
        g2 = gg
print("jaw rise", round(jaw_rise,4), "tcp", np.round(pp2,3))
if g2 is not None:
    print("mask center rise", round(g2.center_xyz_m[2]-centre[2],4), "mask bottom vs rest", round(g2.aabb_min_xyz_m[2]-REST_BOTTOM,4))
else:
    print("roller not re-localized after lift")
if jaw_rise < 0.10:
    handoff("jaw rise below task threshold", jaw_rise_m=jaw_rise)
print("VERIFIED jaw rise", round(jaw_rise,4), "m above the grasp-lift height")
